tools.name: pinterest_search
tools.description: Search Pinterest pins by keyword (any language) for visual inspiration. Returns title, description, full-size image_url with width/height, dominant colour, source website, board and save count for each pin; video pins also get video_url (MP4) and video_seconds. Pins whose largest image is under 500px wide are marked low_res: true; skip them when you need a full-size reference. Set media to "video" for motion/interaction references. Promoted pins are filtered out. Use next_bookmark to page further. Tips: English keywords usually return more results; add words like "ui", "app", "dribbble", "poster", "moodboard" to steer the style.

limit.description: How many pins to return (1-100, default 20)

bookmark.description: Pass next_bookmark from a previous call to get the next page

media.description: Only return video pins ("video"), only still images ("image"), or both (default)

previews.description: Also attach small thumbnails of the first N pins so you can actually look at them (0-16, default 0). Use this when judging visual style, layout or colour matters.

tools.name: pinterest_get_pin
tools.description: Get full details for one pin from its link or numeric id: full description, image, source website, board, creator, saves, comments. Anonymous search ids (e1_…) cannot be looked up — their data is already in the search result.

pin.description: A pin link (pinterest.com/pin/123…/, any regional domain, or a pin.it short link) or a numeric pin id

preview.description: Attach a thumbnail of the image

tools.name: pinterest_related_pins
tools.description: Find pins visually and topically similar to a given pin ("More like this"). Needs a real pin link or numeric id.

pin.description: A pin link (pinterest.com/pin/123…/, any regional domain, or a pin.it short link) or a numeric pin id

limit.description: How many pins to return (1-100, default 20)

bookmark.description: Pass next_bookmark from a previous call to get the next page

media.description: Only return video pins ("video"), only still images ("image"), or both (default)

previews.description: Also attach small thumbnails of the first N pins so you can actually look at them (0-16, default 0). Use this when judging visual style, layout or colour matters.

tools.name: pinterest_board_pins
tools.description: List the pins saved on a public board, e.g. one found in a search result's board.url. Accepts a board URL (pinterest.com/<user>/<board>/) or "<user>/<board>".

limit.description: How many pins to return (1-200, default 25)

bookmark.description: Pass next_bookmark from a previous call to get the next page

media.description: Only return video pins ("video"), only still images ("image"), or both (default)

previews.description: Also attach small thumbnails of the first N pins so you can actually look at them (0-16, default 0). Use this when judging visual style, layout or colour matters.

tools.name: pinterest_preview_images
tools.description: Fetch small thumbnails of pin images (image_url values from other tools) so you can see them. Up to 16 at a time.

size.description: Thumbnail width; larger costs more tokens

tools.name: pinterest_download
tools.description: Save pin images (image_url) and videos (video_url MP4s) to disk; images at full resolution, falling back to 736px when the original is unavailable. Default location: /tmp/Downloads/pinterest-mcp/<folder>. Returns the saved file paths.

image_urls.description: image_url or video_url values from other tools (*.pinimg.com)

folder.description: Sub-folder name, e.g. the search topic

tools.name: dribbble_search
tools.description: Search Dribbble shots by keyword for UI, product, brand and illustration references. Each shot has title, tags, image_url (full-size original on cdn.dribbble.com), video_url (MP4) or gif_url for animated shots, dominant colour, designer and designer_url, likes, views and publish date. Dribbble only gives logged-out visitors the first batch of search results (about 36-48 shots), so next_page is usually empty; for more, try other keywords, dribbble_explore, or a designer's dribbble_user_shots. English keywords work best.

limit.description: How many shots to return (1-48, default 24)

media.description: Only animated shots ("video": MP4 or GIF), only still images ("image"), or both (default)

previews.description: Also attach small thumbnails of the first N shots so you can actually look at them (0-16, default 0). Use this when judging visual style, layout or colour matters.

tools.name: dribbble_explore
tools.description: Browse Dribbble's popular or recent shots, optionally within a category (animation, branding, illustration, mobile, print, product-design, typography, web-design). Pages normally. Each shot has title, tags, image_url (full-size original on cdn.dribbble.com), video_url (MP4) or gif_url for animated shots, dominant colour, designer and designer_url, likes, views and publish date.

limit.description: How many shots to return (1-100, default 24)

page.description: Start page; pass next_page from a previous call to continue

media.description: Only animated shots ("video": MP4 or GIF), only still images ("image"), or both (default)

previews.description: Also attach small thumbnails of the first N shots so you can actually look at them (0-16, default 0). Use this when judging visual style, layout or colour matters.

tools.name: dribbble_user_shots
tools.description: List the shots on a designer's or team's profile, e.g. a designer_url from another result. Accepts dribbble.com/<name>, "@name" or "name". Pages normally. Each shot has title, tags, image_url (full-size original on cdn.dribbble.com), video_url (MP4) or gif_url for animated shots, dominant colour, designer and designer_url, likes, views and publish date.

limit.description: How many shots to return (1-100, default 24)

page.description: Start page; pass next_page from a previous call to continue

media.description: Only animated shots ("video": MP4 or GIF), only still images ("image"), or both (default)

previews.description: Also attach small thumbnails of the first N shots so you can actually look at them (0-16, default 0). Use this when judging visual style, layout or colour matters.

tools.name: dribbble_preview_images
tools.description: Fetch small JPEG thumbnails of shot images (image_url values from other tools) so you can see them. Up to 16 at a time. Animated shots: pass image_url, which is their still frame.

width.description: Thumbnail width; larger costs more tokens

tools.name: dribbble_download
tools.description: Save shot originals to disk: image_url (full-resolution PNG/JPG), video_url (MP4) or gif_url. Default location: /tmp/Downloads/dribbble-mcp/<folder>. Returns the saved file paths. Shots belong to their designers: use downloads as private references and keep the shot_url for credit.

folder.description: Sub-folder name, e.g. the search topic
